about: The collecta of the formulary “Ascension of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that we who believe Thine only-begotten Son, our Redeemer, to have ascended this day into heaven may ourselves also dwell in mind amid heavenly things. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
